title: Entity text search
responsibility: Ranks revision-bound entity search results using names, identifiers, purpose and contract terms.

inputs.name: entitySearch.entries
inputs.description: The SearchEntry objects to search: each needs a string id, name and purpose and a string[] terms, which the function reads without checking, while category only orders tied results. The function does not change them and returns these same objects, so each result keeps its category and commit.

examples.name: Evidence grid
examples.purpose: Shows the evidence rows of one revision with their status.

examples.name: Entity text search
examples.purpose: Ranks revision-bound entity search results using names, identifiers, purpose and contract terms.

examples.name: Revision summary
examples.purpose: Holds the counts shown for one revision.

inputs.name: entitySearch.query
inputs.description: Whitespace-separated words, matched case-insensitively and each on its own against an entry's name, id, purpose or contract terms; an entry is returned only when every word matches. A blank query (empty or only whitespace) returns no results.

inputs.name: entitySearch.limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of results, defaulting to 20 when the argument is omitted or undefined; it is applied after ranking with array slicing, so 0 returns no results and a negative value returns every result except its last |limit|.

outputs.name: entitySearch
outputs.description: The entries that match every query word, as the same objects that were passed in, sorted by the sum over the query words of each word's best tier score (exact name or id 100, name prefix 80, id or id-part prefix 70, name-word prefix 60, name or id substring 40, purpose substring 20, contract-term substring 10), then by the category's index in explorerCategories (unknown categories last), then by name with localeCompare. The sorted list is cut to limit by array slicing, and a blank query returns an empty array.
